limits: Documentation is not runtime evidence. No independent identity attestation, provider-internal attempt bound or remote cancellation acknowledgement was established.
method: Public documentation via web tool only; no inference, authenticated API, model-list, account or connectivity endpoint calls.

sources.finding: Explicit model selection, both intended model IDs, tool controls and response/model telemetry are documented; no inspected guarantee of a one-HTTP-request mode.
Google documents gemini-3.8-flash. This is not proof of Copilot account access or a fixed weight revision.
generateContent accepts explicit contents, system instruction and tool definitions; response metadata includes modelVersion, responseId and usageMetadata.
Direct API identifier is claude-haiku-5-5; the intended Copilot identifier uses dots. Mapping requires approval, not silent string substitution.
Messages API accepts model, messages, system and tools; no agent runner is needed for a tool-free call.
Python SDK retries by default; max_retries=0 is documented. No local installation or runtime qualification.
Exact requested model is documented for the API. Account entitlement and served revision remain unverified.
Provider HTTP and stream retry settings are documented; this does not establish installed-binary behavior or suppress agent turns/tools.
Responses can use explicit supplied context; previous_response_id and conversation state must not be imported for independent qualification requests.
POST /v1/systemone accepts model, state and named typed questions; response has model, answers and usage. Example model value is an alias; a response model field need not prove a resolved version.
At inspection, documentation maps jev-latest and jev-preview to jev-1.14.0 and describes versioned IDs. No account listing was called. Do not silently replace jev-latest.
RetryPolicy.max_retries=0 disables SDK retries according to documentation. SDK is not installed in the inspected environment.
HTTP error bodies are documented. Vendor advice to retry 429/529 must be overridden by the first-attempt contract.
